title: Connect
intro: Church is more than a Sunday service. We learn, eat, pray, serve, and spend time together throughout the year.

sections.heading: Church office
sections.text: The church office is normally open Tuesday - Friday from 9 am to 1 pm.

sections.heading: Adult Formation
sections.text: Our adult formation opportunities explore Scripture, faith, and the questions people bring to Christian life. Current opportunities can be listed here.

sections.heading: Fellowship
sections.text: Coffee hour, parish meals, seasonal events, and informal gatherings give us time to know one another beyond worship.

sections.heading: Stay informed
sections.text: Use the email and text signup links at the top of the page to receive parish news, worship information, and upcoming events.
